//: Release-time build config, baked into signed builds by scripts/tauri-export.mjs.
//githubOAuthClientId: Public OAuth client id for the device-flow GitHub app (issue #1338). Client IDs are PUBLIC, not secrets — this is baked into the packaged server so a fresh install can render the 'Connect GitHub' device-flow CTA. Copy this file to o8.release.json (gitignored) and paste the client id. A GITHUB_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID env var at build time overrides this. Absent → device flow stays disabled.
//sentryDsn: Sentry crash/error reporting DSN (telemetry ruling). DSNs are ingest-only (not a secret) but treat them as deployment config. Baked into the packaged server + native shell so the desktop app reports crashes tagged with the app version + plan. Copy this file to o8.release.json (gitignored) and paste the DSN. A SENTRY_DSN env var at build time overrides this. Absent → Sentry stays fully dormant (no init, no network). Respect the in-app 'Crash & error reports' toggle regardless.
